action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage over all legal moves to find forcing tactics and best king safety/development options.
action.rationale: Position: two knights, queens on. Black queen on d5 hits e5 knight and b5 pawn structure; d4 pawn and b5 pawn are loose. White has undeveloped c1/f1 bishops and uncastled king. Initial broad sweep needed before committing.
